law_name: Personal Data Protection Law (Decree No. 144 of 2024)
key_requirements: Express informed consent (Arts. 5, 27); ARCO-POL rights; privacy officer; transfers only to adequate countries (Art. 44); 72h breach notice (firm summary)
retention_period: Art. 5(h) temporality principle: keep data only for the period needed to achieve processing purposes; consent must state storage period (Art. 5)
enforcement_authority: Agencia de Ciberseguridad del Estado (ACE), per Human Rights Watch; another source names the new National Digital Authority
penalties_range: Up to 40 monthly minimum wages, commerce sector (~USD 14,600) for very serious infractions (unconfirmed)
exemptions: Art. 2 excludes: purely family/domestic processing (non-commercial); public security, defence, State security, crime prevention/investigation; public registries
notes: First general data-protection law (approved 12 Nov 2024); date shown is gazette publication. The earlier row described a law that does not exist
